theorem: k=4 factorization (verified exactly at N=53, q=1, dev<1e-9)
statement: A4_S(q) = sum_{i,j in S}|J(chi_i,chi_j;q)|^4 = m^2 * Sigma_4(q) where Sigma_4(q) = sum over (x,y,z,w) in (F_N^*)^4, x,y,z,w not in {0,1}, with constraints xz/(yw) in H and (x-1)(z-1)/((y-1)(w-1)) in H, of e_N(q[(x-y)+(z-w)]). The constraint variety is 2-dimensional (423879 points at N=53) — the Katz-tier surface of R82.35, now EXPLICITLY identified.
note: The k=2 constraint set was zero-dimensional (pairs); k=4 is a surface — the dimension jump IS the R82.35 hierarchy boundary.
